title: Rollout rail and cost-sparkline component library + token spec
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and publish a compact, accessible component set for rollout rails and inline cost sparklines used across the Console. Deliverables include a Figma component library, a token naming convention (color/spacing/typography) tailored for high-density dashboards, interaction guidelines for rollout states (canary, gradual, rollback), and documented handoff notes for engineering. Aim is consistent visual language between Rollouts, Deployments, and Cost Insights while reducing bespoke implementations across product teams.
acceptance_criteria: Figma library published with named components: RolloutRail, RolloutStep, CostSparkline, BudgetPill, AnomalyChip
Token spec (colors, elevation, spacing, radii) documented in Figma and a single markdown file in design ops repo
Contrast tested and WCAG AA compliant for primary and critical states of RolloutRail and CostSparkline
One interactive prototype covering a 3-step rollout flow with cost overlay and anomaly indicator
Handoff checklist completed with engineering: tokens, responsive behavior, accessibility notes, animation specs
Design review signed off by PM (Riley Thompson) and Eng lead (Sana Mehta)
decisions: Use semantic tokens: 'surface-1', 'accent-positive', 'accent-warning', 'ink-strong' instead of per-component hex values to enable theme parity between hosted and private deployments
Sparkline thumbnails will be lightweight SVGs with color tokens and a single data point highlight; not a full charting dependency to keep bundle small
Rollout rail will default to compact spacing (4px grid) for high-density dashboards, but expose 'comfortable' variants via token overrides
Anomaly indicator uses a small 'chip' with an outlined state to avoid heavy visual weight; chips are keyboard-focusable and announce via aria-live in the Console
